M11.01.note: Approved narration treats retrograde P timing as an observation, not a precise upper/middle/lower nodal-focus locator. Source examples illustrate visible timing only; no retrograde wavefront or new AV-node anatomy is modeled.

M11.02.note: A PJC is premature and differs from an escape event in timing. No verified PJC or preceding-pause/late-escape sequence is supplied; this lesson remains entirely explanation only.

M11.03.note: Rate labels are teaching conventions with variable boundaries; they do not establish circulation or fixed 1:1 atrial/ventricular timing. Existing known escape/accelerated/tachycardic examples are different recordings, not a controlled rate-change experiment.

M11.04.note: Formal SVT is broader than bedside regular narrow-complex shorthand. The clipped existing source example supports only a broad regular narrow-complex tachycardia interpretation, not AVNRT/AVRT, exact atrial focus, calibrated rate, onset or termination.

M11.05.note: Overlapping rates and unavailable atrial activity limit mechanism inference. Medication dosing, cardioversion and treatment escalation from source examples are deliberately omitted. No image supports a clinical action or individual safety/risk conclusion.
